verdict.rationale: The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a discrete GPU, and registrable outbound HTTP webhook subscriptions are a web-service capability, so this axis does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows AMD shipping a webhook system for the card. The closest items, ROCm profiler tracing and debug-agent signal handling, are local developer tools rather than HTTP callbacks, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
